Object::domain inserts names from both bundles and borrowed into the same listed BTreeSet. covers_d then checks only whether every required interface name occurs in that set. The four tested rows vary u and the borrowed bit only. CNOT and identity agree on those rows because interface t is always zero.

On the omitted input t=1,u=0 with borrowed b=0, §4.4 gives @a output (1,1,0), while @identity gives (1,0,0). Independent run-action executions reproduce mut=[1,1] versus [1,0]. The initial fallible transfer_bytes reservation succeeds. step then sets state.pending to the request. Outside the execute closure and its undo-on-Err path, history construction calls self.state.pending.clone(), whose derived HostRequest clone infallibly clones the full Vec<u8>. GDB identifies Vec<u8>::clone -> HostRequest::clone -> Option<HostRequest>::clone -> ClassicalMachine::step at classical.rs:1567. The second 64-MiB allocation exceeds the process limit and invokes the allocator abort handler. There is no recoverable Result and no rollback. This is the obligatory retention stage of the same text-driven transfer, not an arbitrarily pre-filled resident heap.

The original 2^63 hostcall and console inputs now return cited host-limit Results, leave the full snapshot unchanged, publish no request/tape/output and reverse to entry. Their 0/1/8 controls succeed. At 64 MiB the console control also rejects cleanly at its cumulative console reservation and restores the prefix.
